credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-built in tools/art/species_f/ (Round 4). Subject: Malus domestica (orchard apple); drawn from its botany, not traced from any photo.
notes: BOBBING: a glossy pip tipped at the foe on a forked radicle, its sprout flicked back like a plume. Accent: the wine of the apple skin (dark slot). Sport: Malus 'Royalty' (purple-leaved crabapple: bronze-purple leaves, crimson-pink blossom, dark fruit).
